description.narrative: The Project seeks to provide a combination of investment and investment preparation support to Zagrebacki Holding d.o.o. (ZGH or the Company) to facilitate holistic transformation of Zagrebs waste management, road maintenance and construction and green landscaping sectors into modern, efficient and sustainable system that incorporates circular economy principles and advance the development of green cities agenda. The Project strengthens strategic partnership with the Company, building on IFCs EUR72.5m subscription as an anchor investor into a EUR305m Sustainability Linked Bond issuance in July 2023.

The Project upgrades the quality of waste management, road maintenance and green landscaping services in Zagreb and enables its transition into a holistic, efficient and sustainable system with circular economy principles. The main expected project-level outcomes are stakeholder effects through the improvement in the quality of municipal infrastructure and services and environmental effects through a reduction in GHG emissions. At the sector level, the Project is expected to have replication potential for similar circular waste management initiatives in the region and encourage further investments.
